decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The release-note line [ev-4ae6a331ae89] is only a title, but the linked PR fills in the details. It adds support for creating AWS Secrets Manager secrets with tags, a description and a KMS key [ev-73c7539b26ae], and the changed files are confined to the AWS Secrets Manager provider [ev-70a8f45e3137]. [ev-285fd18823f4] names the subject and states a breaking change: PushSecret metadata for this provider moves from a flat `metadata: secretPushFormat` to a structured `apiVersion: kubernetes.external-secrets.io/v1alpha1, kind: PushSecretMetadata, spec: {secretPushFormat, ...}` object. That makes applicability decidable: PushSecrets that target the AWS Secrets Manager provider and set the old flat metadata (e.g. secretPushFormat). The excerpt is cut off where it describes default behaviour, but that does not affect the open aspects (subject, applicability).
